verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a local skills/plugin framework with no evidence of a backend data store, but release notes do show intentional cleanup behavior: per-plan workspace directories are deleted once review is clean, with git history serving as the durable record, and worktree removal is guarded against silently destroying uncommitted files. This is thin, incidental evidence of local artifact retention/deletion rather than a documented privacy/data-retention policy. Missing for 10: no documentation of conversation/telemetry data handling, no explicit user-facing retention/deletion controls or settings, no policy on what data (if any) is sent to or stored by third parties.
